title: Public API Readiness Map

authorityBoundary.repositoryAuthority: This artefact records bounded current-main public API contract readiness derived from USF semantic definitions, interface contracts, route contract metadata, the OpenAPI projection, and the client-callable contract map.
authorityBoundary.openapiAuthority: OpenAPI remains a lower-authority projection and does not define USF semantic authority, public deployment readiness, external availability, staging, production, or live-provider readiness.
authorityBoundary.linearAuthority: Linear tracks work only and does not define USF semantic authority.
authorityBoundary.sourceCodeBoundary: Source code and OpenAPI output are used only when bound to semantic/interface contracts and validator-enforced current-main anchors.

versioningCompatibilityAndDocs.deprecationPolicy: deprecationStatus and OpenAPI deprecated flag must remain consistent; removed or sunset operations require explicit repository authority before exposure.

consumerSecurityAndTelemetry.securityBoundary: Consumer security semantics are current-main contract metadata only; live gateway, edge WAF, TLS termination, live IdP, public FQDN, and production enforcement are not claimed.
